reason.why: A real-time video codec's value is the computation itself: compressing and decompressing video frames in real time. It isn't a set of stateful records that an agent reads and changes through an API, so a deterministic world can't replicate it. What would make it feasible: Ask for a system built around records, such as a video transcoding job queue with jobs, presets, and statuses (queued, running, done, failed), or a media asset library with renditions and publish actions.
